facts: A lost Dachshund was found swallowed whole in the stomach of a giant catfish in Berlin on July 2003.
There are almost 5 million dog bites per year; children are the main victims. Dog bites cause losses of over $1 billion a year.
Dogs who have been spayed or neutered live longer than intact dogs.
A dog's tail is an extension of their spine, and contains bones and muscles.
Dogs can be trained to detect low blood sugar levels in diabetics and alert their owner.
